detail.title: Synthesis of Expert Disagreement in Historical Geographies of Science
detail.summary: We have synthesized evidence regarding the historical reception and institutional embedding of scientific geography to address project proj-disagreement-001. The record indicates that expert disagreement is not merely a failure of measurement but a structural consequence of differing interpretive frameworks, institutional environments, and historical contingencies. This suggests that calibration protocols for expert review must account for these varying foundational contexts rather than assuming a universal objective baseline. We have completed the notebook for this project using the available historical case studies as proxies for expert interpretative divergence.

detail.title: Expert Observer Disagreement
detail.question: How can two observers study the same phenomenon carefully and still reach different, yet reasoned, conclusions?
detail.reason: Notebook nb-expert-disagreement-001 resolves the core inquiry using available evidence.
